the slowdown is in-process."}]}],"propagation":[{"from":"ts-route-plan-service","to":"ts-travel-plan-service","evidence":[{"kind":"trace","sql":"SELECT p.service_name AS caller, p.span_name AS caller_span, c.service_name AS callee, c.span_name AS callee_span, count(*) n, approx_quantile(c.duration,0.5)/1e6 callee_med_ms, approx_quantile(p.duration,0.5)/1e6 caller_med_ms FROM abnormal_traces c JOIN abnormal_traces p ON c.parent_span_id=p.span_id AND c.trace_id=p.trace_id WHERE c.span_name IN ('POST /api/v1/routeplanservice/routePlan/cheapestRoute','POST /api/v1/routeplanservice/routePlan/quickestRoute') GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY n DESC","claim":"Travel-plan's calls to route-plan's cheapestRoute and quickestRoute take about 1858 ms, matching the route-plan delay."}]},{"from":"ts-travel-plan-service","to":"ts-ui-dashboard","evidence":[{"kind":"trace","sql":"SELECT p.service_name AS caller, p.span_name AS caller_span, c.service_name AS callee, c.span_name AS callee_span, count(*) n, approx_quantile(c.duration,0.5)/1e6 callee_med_ms, approx_quantile(p.duration,0.5)/1e6 caller_med_ms FROM abnormal_traces c JOIN abnormal_traces p ON c.parent_span_id=p.span_id AND c.trace_id=p.trace_id WHERE c.span_name IN ('POST /api/v1/travelplanservice/travelPlan/cheapest','POST /api/v1/travelplanservice/travelPlan/quickest') GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY n DESC","claim":"Dashboard's travelPlan cheapest and quickest calls take about 1862 ms, matching travel-plan's delayed calls."}]}]}
